candidats.description: Main entrance of the LVM building, Münster , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The origins of today’s LVM campus date back to 1967, when the company moved into its premises on Kolde-Ring at the corner of Weseler Straße. The campus’s seven insurance buildings are located south of Münster city center. The northern part of Von-Stauffenberg-Straße runs through the campus, while Sperlichstraße forms its southern boundary. The LVM buildings were constructed between 1965 and 2014. The insurance company’s three high-rise buildings in particular are part of Münster’s skyline . The ground-level sculpture

candidats.description: Eingangsportal der Kohlenwäsche (Gebäude A14) der Zeche Zollverein , Schachtanlage XII, in Essen , aufgenommen von unterhalb der Schrägbandbrücke. Den Eingang rahmt ein charakteristischer roter Stahlbogen. Das Gebäude beherbergt heute das Ruhr Museum .

candidats.description: Built in 1948-1949, this Romanesque Revival-style building was constructed to house the Walton Christian Church, which began in 1873 and was organized in 1876. The building replaced a previous church on the same site, built in 1918, which burned in a devastating fire on Thanksgiving Day in 1947.
